hazard: A completion entry defers work to a later task with no owner, no task does it, and the broken promise surfaces only at finalize review after every task has merged.

grader.pattern: (?s)(?=.*Collect every "Task N \.\.\." deferral named in a \*\*Spec deviations\*\* entry)(?=.*the promised edit is present in the referenced diff)(?=.*the task or fix pull request that carries it has merged)(?=.*an open fix pull request, is not proof)(?=.*An unresolved deferral stops the run)
